name: branding-vego-flourish-g-wordmark-over-dewy-tomato-photo
title: High-contrast serif 'VEGO' with an oversized swash G over a close photo of a dewy heirloom tomato
whatItIs: A white field with a black flared serif wordmark 'VEGO' where the G is drawn larger with a leafy flourish overlapping the E and O, placed above a close-up photo of a red tomato with green calyx and water droplets cropped at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Fresh and elegant; the swash G feels like a vine tendril and the tomato proves freshness.
techniques: Overlap an oversized swash letter onto neighbours.
Pair a black serif with a saturated red photo.
Crop the photo at the bottom.
bestFor: Serif wordmarks with a signature letter

vocabulary.definition: A letter with a decorative flourish.
A close photo of fruit or vegetables.
